newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed, sentiment weak.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end mixed, sentiment weak.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures finished mixed on Thursday, with the metal's overnight rise in London providing little encouragement, traders said.

"Sentiment is weak. People are not sure if the economy (in Japan) is continuing its recovery," said one trader. "Their patience has run out after prices fell through the key $1,600 this week," he said.
TOCOM benchmark April 1998 lost 0.4 yen to end at 191.3 yen per kg, while others ranged between 0.9 yen higher and 0.2 weaker.
Estimated trade volume was 2,956 lots, compared with 3,510 lots on Wednesday.
In London on Wednesday, aluminium was relatively stable finishing at $1,592, up from the previous close helped by technical factors.
